_comment: Provenance manifest for chematic-mcp's 2026-07-28-RC implementation. Every entry below was fetched live over the network during this work session (curl/gh api against github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol) -- nothing here was reconstructed from model training-data memory of older MCP versions (2024-11-05 / 2025-03-26 / 2025-06-18 / 2025-11-25).

instructed_pin.role: authoritative schema source per task instructions (section 0)
instructed_pin.tag_verified_via: GET /repos/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/git/refs/tags/2026-07-28-RC -> object.sha == 9d700ed62dcf86cb77475c9b81930611a9182f46 (confirmed: the given short SHA IS the actual tagged RC, not an arbitrary/stale commit)

files_fetched.note: source of truth used for types/fields; LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION literally read as "2026-07-28" at line 37
normative source for dual-era stdio negotiation (server/discover probe -> -32601 fallback to legacy initialize)
stdio framing section (newline-delimited, MUST NOT embed newlines, stderr-only diagnostics) confirms current implementation's transport assumptions unchanged
confirms ping/initialize/notifications-roots-list-changed were REMOVED (not merely deprecated) in this revision -- section 4 of the task brief assumed ping survives into the modern era; it does not.
confirms resultType is REQUIRED on every modern Result (absent = legacy-server "complete" per backward-compat rule); confirms JSON Schema 2020-12 is the required default dialect

instructed_pin.example_fixtures_fetched_dir: schema/draft/examples/*  (24 example JSON files: DiscoverRequest, DiscoverResult, DiscoverResultResponse, ListToolsResult, CallToolResult x4, error responses x6, Tool x5, CallToolRequest, ServerCapabilities) -- used as literal wire-shape ground truth, not summarized from memory

post_rc_untagged_drift_checked_for_recon.role: NOT the pin -- checked only because 3 independent signals (this repo's own task brief section 9, the official rmcp Rust SDK, and this file) disagreed with the RC tag's error-code values, so the disagreement needed to be resolved with evidence before writing code
post_rc_untagged_drift_checked_for_recon.ref: main (untagged, no 2026-07-28 final tag exists yet as of this fetch)
post_rc_untagged_drift_checked_for_recon.final_tag_check_command: GET /repos/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/git/refs/tags/2026-07-28 -> not found; GET .../tags?per_page=10 lists 2026-07-28-RC (2026-05-29) as the newest 2026-07-28-series tag

files_fetched.diff_vs_rc_pin: full diff run (356 lines); substantive (non-cosmetic) hunks: (1) MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY renumbered -32003 -> -32021; (2) UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION renumbered -32004 -> -32022; (3) new HEADER_MISMATCH = -32020 constant + a documented MCP error-code allocation scheme (-32000..-32019 implementation-defined, -32020..-32099 reserved for the spec, allocated sequentially from -32020); (4) io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo softened from required to optional on RequestMetaObject; (5) new NotificationMetaObject/ResultMetaObject types, the latter adding an optional io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo _meta key; (6) DiscoverResult changed from `extends Result` to `extends CacheableResult` (gains ttlMs/cacheScope) and its top-level `serverInfo` field was deleted from the interface text; (7) several elicitation/subscriptions/cancellation-only changes out of this server's scope (no resources/prompts/sampling/subscriptions implemented here)

corroborating_sdk_evidence.role: used only to break ties between the RC pin and the untagged main-branch drift above -- never used as a schema source in place of the primary source
findings: crates/rmcp/src/model.rs defines UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION = -32022, MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY = -32021, RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND = -32002 (legacy-only) -- agrees with main-branch drift, NOT the RC-tag pin

rmcp's DiscoverResult struct keeps `server_info: Implementation` as a top-level required field WHILE ALSO adding ttl_ms/cache_scope -- i.e. a hybrid of the RC-tag shape and the main-branch CacheableResult change, not a pure adoption of either; this server's DiscoverResult follows that same hybrid, on the reasoning that a real shipping SDK's pragmatic choice is stronger evidence than an untagged doc-comment deletion
rmcp keeps client_info as a non-Option (required) field -- agrees with the RC-tag pin over main-branch's softening to optional; this server also treats clientInfo as required

release notes for rmcp-v3.0.0-beta.1 (PR #973 server discovery/negotiation SEP-2575, #999 stateless-serving-of-2026-07-28 SEP-2567, #889/#1025 CacheableResult SEP-2549, #1038 'omit resultType for legacy protocol sessions') independently converged on the same legacy/modern split this implementation uses

decision_error_codes_shipped.rationale: Shipped the main-branch/rmcp values (-32020/-32021/-32022), NOT the RC tag's own -32003/-32004, because three independent sources agree (spec main HEAD, rmcp v3.0.0-beta.2, and this task's own brief section 9 naming these exact numbers) and the RC tag's numbers are demonstrably superseded before the final even ships. HEADER_MISMATCH (-32020) is defined but never emitted by this stdio-only server (no HTTP headers exist to mismatch); MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY (-32021) is defined but never emitted (this server requires zero client capabilities) -- both are reserved constants with dedicated negative-control/conformance rows marked not_applicable, never wired to a fake trigger.
